name: Yagami Touko
source:
The owner of the cafe "Stardust."
The cafe was originally founded by her husband, but just when things were looking bright, he departed this world.
She was at a loss whether to part with the store and start working not just for herself but also to raise her son, but decided not to abandon the store left behind by her husband and took up managing it herself.

However, her husband's popular coffee blend was no longer available, thus leading to a gradual decrease in customers. The cafe is now a gathering spot for Anoyama's elderly and the sales slump continues, so the business is in a tough spot.

She has her hands full with the store and is worried that she can't do anything for her son.

[Translated from [url=http://venus66.sakura.ne.jp/touko.html]the official site[/url]]
